+"""Parse duration values: comma-separated items in brackets."""
+
+from lamina.errors import ParseError
+
+
+def parse_duration_value(raw: str, line: int, column: int, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> list[str]:
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(raw)
+    strippedText = raw.strip()
+    if not (strippedText.startswith("[") and strippedText.endswith("]")):
+        raise ValueError(f"expected [items], got {raw!r}")
+    inner = strippedText[1:-1].strip()
+    if not inner:
+        return []
+    items = [part.strip() for part in inner.split(",")]
+    if any(item == "" for item in items):
+        raise ParseError("empty item in list", line, column)
+    return items
